def run(args):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout

head=run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).strip()
status=run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).strip()

    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} status={status!r}")

for rel in [
    "src/do_again/core/schema.py",

    "src/do_again/service/runtime.py",
]:

    print(f"=== {rel} ===")
    lines=p.read_text().splitlines()
    needles=[
        "def validate_request", "def request_fingerprint", "expires_at_utc",
        "issued_at_utc", "operation", "continuation", "publish_json",
        "def sync", "require_git", "git push", "_ensure_control_worktree",
        "_sync", "control_worktree"
    ]
    hits=[]
    for i,line in enumerate(lines,1):
        if any(n.lower() in line.lower() for n in needles):
            hits.append(i)
    seen=set()

        start=max(1,i-7); end=min(len(lines),i+24)
        if any(n in seen for n in range(start,end+1)):
            continue
